skills.description: Generate an interactive, step-through animation of a sorting algorithm, searching algorithm, or data structure (stack, queue, linked list, binary tree, etc). Use this skill whenever the user names an algorithm or data structure and wants to understand, teach, learn, or visualize it — even if they don't say the word "animation" or "visualize" explicitly. Trigger on phrases like "explain bubble sort", "how does binary search work", "show me a linked list", "help my kid understand quicksort", or any request to see how an algorithm/data structure behaves step by step. Always use this skill instead of building a one-off visual from scratch — it defines the reusable interaction pattern (play/step/reset controls, status line, counters) and points to per-topic action-generation logic.
